Achhi tarah jeene ke liye thoda chaahiye.
Log ahankar ke uthle paani me doobte hain.
Jeevan ek natak hai; apana kirdar achhe se nibhao.
Chalak dimaag qabr mein bhi roshni dhoondh leta hai.
Teekha dimaag dhokhe ko lohe ki tarah kaat deta hai.
Ek mazak nafrat ki sabse badi khaai ko jod sakta hai.
Gyaan andhe ki aankh hai.
Vyang wo naavik hai jo pagalpan ke beech nikalta hai.
Ek khushnuma mazak dukh ki sabse acchi dawa hai.
Ek chatur jawab apmaan ke khilaf kavach hai.
Baanta gaya dukh aadha bojh halka kar deta hai.
Ek teekha vyang kadwe dushman ko nishastra karta hai.
Garv achanak patan se pahle aaye.
Vyang andheri khopadi me roshni ki chamak hai.
Teekha mazak sabse bhari andhere ko chirta hai.
Buddhi zameen khojti hai, dil unhe aabaad karta hai.
Gyan wo langar hai jo shak me bhi mazboot rehta hai.
Buddhi tez vichar ki khubsurti hai.
Dimaag ankahe shabdon ke samandar ka naksha banata hai.
Dil dimaag ke khilaf ek baaghi hai.
Dimaag ke samudra ka koi naksha banaya hua tat nahi.
Teekha dimaag pareshaan paani me banta hai.
Buddhi talwar ki dhaar par naachti hai.
Teekha dimaag jhooth ko aasani se cheer deta hai.
Tohfe mein mile ghode ke daant nahi ginne chahiye.
Vyang ghoomte dimaag ka langar hai.
Dimaag wahi nark banata hai jisse woh darta hai.
Dhiraj kadvi jad ko meetha kare.
Moorkh mann ki baat bolta hai; gyaani ispar niyantran rakhta hai.
Hum apne banaye samudraon par behte hain.
Prasann hriday mehnat ko naach me badal deta hai.
Aane wala kal aaj ka vidyarthi hai.
Tez dimaag sabse tez rath se bhi aage nikal jata hai.
Ek chatur tippani jeebh par dhalas sona hai.
Rooh yaadon ke mahalon mein naachti hai.
Kadva dil apne hi kuen ko zehrila karta hai.
Samajhdar manushya kinare par kudne se pehle dekhta hai.
Moorh shor khoje; gyaani gahrai khoje.
Buddhi pake hue dimaag ka phool hai.
Pachhatawa keedo ka bhojan hai.
Ek chatur jeebh shahi farmaan se behtar hai.
Rooh kismat ke tarashe raaston par chalti hai.
Log un satyo par thokar khate hain jo jhooth hona chahte hain.
Sabse chalak jaal banane wale ko hi pakad leta hai.
Ghamand sabse bade dimaag ki tabaahi hai.
Shor machaati bheed mein gyan dheere se bolta hai.
Atmavishwas me manav disha suchak tezi se ghoomta hai.
